build_deforamble_transformer: build a DeformableTransformer model from argparse args with configurable encoder and decoder layers
DeformableTransformer_forward: run the DeformableTransformer forward pass with multi-scale source features, masks, and positional embeddings
DeformableTransformerEncoderLayer_forwar: run a single encoder layer with multi-scale deformable attention and feed-forward network
DeformableTransformerDecoderLayer_forwar: run a single decoder layer with self-attention, cross-attention, and feed-forward network
DeformableTransformer_get_proposal_pos_e: compute sinusoidal position embeddings from bounding box proposals in cx, cy, w, h format
